$comment: Source of truth for the italic theme variants. The *-italic.json files under themes/
are generated from their base theme by `npm run build` -- never edit them by hand.
Colors always come from the base file, so the two variants can never drift apart.
Only the scopes listed here differ, by gaining fontStyle: italic.
Note: 'Doc Comment' is intentionally italic in dark only -- doc comments already read
as a distinct green there, and italicising them in light hurt legibility.
